thumbnail_texts: 새우젓 때문에 반대? / 서강대 이름의 뜻

image_concepts.A: 1900년대 하와이 사탕수수밭 + 인천항 증기선 배경, 놀란 졸업생과 달러 다발
image_concepts.B: 대학 정문 앞에서 이름의 뜻을 알고 놀란 사람 + 소재 소품(새우젓 항아리 등)

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A. 배경 왼쪽은 1900년대 인천항 증기선, 오른쪽은 하와이 사탕수수밭. 가운데 학사모를 쓴 한국인 졸업생이 놀란 표정으로 오래된 달러 지폐 다발을 들고 있다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail. The background is split: on the left an early 1900s steamship docked at an old Korean harbor in faded sepia tones, on the right sunlit green sugarcane fields in Hawaii. In the center an anonymous young Korean graduate with a warm likeable face, wearing a navy graduation cap and gown, holds a thick stack of vintage US dollar bills, eyes wide and mouth open in exaggerated surprise, upper body large with a crisp cutout look and strong rim light. Vivid realistic colors, intriguing mood.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 변형. 하와이 사탕수수밭에서 밀짚모자를 쓴 1900년대 한국인 이민 노동자(익명)가 땀을 닦고, 그 뒤로 오늘날의 대학 캠퍼스가 겹쳐 보인다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail. On the left, an anonymous early 1900s Korean immigrant laborer in a straw hat and worn work clothes wipes sweat in a Hawaiian sugarcane field, rendered large with a crisp cutout look and rim light. On the right, a modern Korean university campus with a stone main gate fades in under a bright blue sky, as if the two scenes are joined. Warm golden light, vivid realistic colors, moving and curious mood.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B. 글자 없는 대학 정문 앞에서 간판을 올려다보며 깜짝 놀란 대학생, 손에 휴대폰.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail in front of a grand stone university main gate with a blank nameplate. An anonymous Korean university student in their 20s with a warm likeable face looks up at the gate holding a smartphone, eyes wide and jaw dropped in exaggerated surprise, upper body large on the left with a crisp cutout look and strong rim light. Bright blue sky, spring trees, vivid realistic colors.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 변형(서강대). 강가 대학 정문 앞에서 새우젓 항아리를 두 손으로 든 채 당황한 학생, 뒤로 한강.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail with playful humor. An anonymous Korean university student in their 20s with a warm likeable face stands in front of a stone university gate with a blank nameplate, holding a large traditional jar of salted shrimp in both hands and making an exaggerated confused face, upper body large in the center with a crisp cutout look and rim light. A wide river and city bridges stretch behind. Bright daylight, vivid realistic colors.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드(연세대). 오래된 석조 대학 건물과 오래된 붉은 벽돌 병원 건물이 양쪽에 있고, 가운데 졸업생이 두 건물을 양팔로 끌어당겨 하나로 붙이는 모습.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail with playful humor. On the left an old Gothic stone college hall, on the right an old red-brick hospital building from the early 1900s. In the center an anonymous Korean graduate in a cap and gown with a warm likeable face pulls the two buildings together with both arms, straining with an exaggerated determined expression, upper body large with a crisp cutout look and rim light. Bright blue sky, vivid realistic colors.
